paragraphs.text: Porcupine is a creature type for a species of large rodents with defensive spines or quills on the body and tail.

Only 3 porcupines have been printed so far. The acorn creature Treacherous Trapezist which is mono- blue ; and Quilled Charger and Boar-q-pine which are both mono- red . Consequently, they don't have a standard color in which they appear, though this may change in the future.
Porcupine originally debuted as an acorn creature type in Unfinity with Treacherous Trapezist , and later became eternal in Outlaws of Thunder Junction with Quilled Charger .

Ikoria , Ravnica , and Theros have been seen to have beasts with many traits of the porcupine known as the Porcuparrot , Ursapine , and Spirespine respectively. These could be eligible to receive the type in the future.

Domri was featured as a porcupine-folk on Domri,Anarch of Bolas ( BLC ) as part of Imagine: Courageous Critters showcase series. However, Imagine: Courageous Critters explicitly shows non-canon, "What if?" scenarios.
Thunder Junction is home to a large mount known as the Quilled Charger. They are a porcupine beast with small quills on its body and a large tail of quills.
The Un-iverse features a small sentient humanoid porcupine performer who acts in Myra the Magnificent's Intergalactic Astrotorium of Fun .
Avatar: The Last Airbender features the Boar-q-pine, which is a large boar with quills on its back like a porcupine.
